follow-up time: Until delivery or loss of follow-up
exposure: Type of intervention (USG-guided D&C vs hysterotomy)
Treatment with USG-guided D&C or hysterotomy
cohort: 63 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy at a perinatology clinic between January 2016 and April 2020.
finding: USG-guided D&C was successful in treating early cesarean scar pregnancies in the majority of cases and resulted in reproductive outcomes comparable to other treatment modalities.
